_about: Public-domain William John Conybeare (1815-1857), principal of the Liverpool Collegiate Institution and vicar of Axminster, for the Word Hoard: Essays Ecclesiastical and Social, and The Life and Epistles of St Paul, written with J. S. Howson. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 118 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

wjconybeare-essays: Essays ecclesiastical and social (London : Longman, Brown, Green, and Longmans, 1855)
wjconybeare-life-epistles-paul: The life and epistles of St. Paul (London : Longman, Green, Longman, and Roberts, 1861)

_excluded.wjconybeare-others: Illustrations of Anglo-Saxon Poetry is by his father J. J. Conybeare; A History of Cambridgeshire is by Edward Conybeare; the petrifactions and the 1835 Epistles are by others
